create_pipeline_subclass: create a subclass of Pipeline that implements __init__ with model_id and __call__ to process inputs
implement_pipeline_call: implement the __call__ method on a Pipeline subclass to handle arbitrary input and return results
raise_pipeline_exception: raise a PipelineException when a pipeline operation encounters an unrecoverable error
review_pipeline_abc: review the Pipeline abstract base class to understand the required __init__ and __call__ interface
refactor_pipeline_subclass: refactor an existing Pipeline subclass to properly accept model_id and handle inputs in __call__
